subject: Audit window edge-case: midnight inclusivity & bridge-letter timing

Subject: SOC 2 Type II: quick question on audit window inclusivity

Hi Priyom —

Quick one from our compliance team while we review the SOC 2 Type II package: the audit report we received lists the period as 2025-05-01 to 2026-04-30. Can you confirm whether Redwood interprets the end date (2026-04-30) as inclusive for point-in-time evidence taken at 23:59:59 UTC on 2026-04-30?

Our downstream auditors sometimes treat the final second differently (e.g., some internal systems record rollovers at 00:00:00 local time). For procurement we need an explicit statement of inclusivity (or a bridge letter) if your production change that affects controls happened in early May.

If helpful, we can share an example timestamp we want to validate (user provisioning event at 2026-04-30T23:59:45Z). Also: do you have a bridge letter template if coverage needs to be extended into May?

Thanks — appreciate a short confirmation we can attach to our vendor file.

Best,
Elaine Park
Senior Compliance Manager
Acme Cloud

Hi Elaine —

Thanks for the clear example timestamp — that helps. A couple quick clarifying questions so we give you the right artifact: 

- When you say "inclusive for point-in-time evidence," do your auditors accept evidence stamped at <= 2026-04-30T23:59:59Z as within the period, or do they require a signed bridge letter to confirm post-coverage items?
- Is your internal evidence expectation tied to UTC or to a local timezone? Your example looks like UTC — we can confirm how our logs are stored and exported.

We have our SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025-05-01 through 2026-04-30 (inclusive per our reporting team). I can attach the PDF and a draft bridge-letter if you want both. Rishi (cc'd) will confirm log retention/timestamp formats for access provisioning and IAM-related proofs. Monica, looping you in for any evidence formatting we should provide (CSV vs. gzipped logs vs. PDF extracts).

If it helps, we can provide: 
- The SOC 2 Type II report PDF (reporting period header included)
- A short cover note stating our interpretation of the period inclusivity (signed by our Security head)
- A draft bridge letter that states the timeline for changes that occurred in May, if you need continuity beyond 2026-04-30

What would you prefer attached to your vendor file? If you confirm the UTC acceptance, we can send the SOC report and the signed coverage note today.

Thanks,
Priyom Das

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmecloud.com>

Priyom —

Thanks for the quick reply. Confirming the auditor guidance here: timestamps stamped at or before 2026-04-30T23:59:59Z UTC are considered within the 2025-05-01 through 2026-04-30 period. Our example provisioning event (2026-04-30T23:59:45Z) would be acceptable as within scope.

That said, our procurement team asks for a bridge letter when there are production changes that materially affect controls after the report period. In your case, we heard that a configuration change to the customer-key rotation process was deployed on 2026-05-05; if that change affects the controls we tested (IAM/key mgmt), a short bridge letter stating that the control change is documented and whether compensating controls were in place for May 2026 would be useful.

We'd appreciate the following (ideally as a single secure Drive link):
- SOC2_TypeII_2025-05-01_to_2026-04-30.pdf (signed)
- A one-page coverage confirmation note that explicitly states "records stamped at or before 2026-04-30T23:59:59Z UTC are included in the report period" and is signed by Redwood security leadership
- Draft bridge_letter_proposed_may2026.docx (if you can include a short paragraph about the May 5 configuration change and any mitigations)

For our auditors: sample evidence timestamp accepted: 2026-04-30T23:59:45Z (user provisioning event) — so please include the original log line and export format. Logs in UTC are preferred.

ETA: If you can share the SOC PDF and the one-page confirmation today (by EOD PT), that should keep the review moving. Bridge letter can be a follow-up within 2–3 business days.

Thanks — I will add the Drive link to our vendor file once received.

Regards,
Elaine Park
Senior Compliance Manager, Acme Cloud

Attachments: bridge_letter_template_example.pdf (attached)
